text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft and the pilot monitoring read back 12,000 ft. The pilot flying set 11,000 ft and climbed, and the aircraft rose from 8,979 ft to 11,248 ft. Crosscheck said "Readback one-two thousand, cleared one-one thousand" at 26 s.
